subject.title: fix(mattermost): keep finalized preview when a trailing tool-error warning falls back

question: Should the canonical fix consume the Mattermost draft immediately after in-place finalization, or retain this narrower clear-only guard after the current channel-message migration?
rationale: Both open PRs stop the observed deletion but encode different lifecycle contracts, affecting whether later payloads may reuse an already-durable preview.

options.title: Consume finalized draft
options.body: Adopt the consumed-draft approach on current main so every subsequent payload uses normal durable delivery.

options.title: Keep clear-only guard
options.body: Retain this narrower behavior only if an owner confirms finalized drafts may remain reusable and proof covers later finalizable payloads.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Pause both competing PRs if the current channel-message migration should own a replacement regression fix.

recommendation.title: Consume finalized draft
recommendation.body: Adopt the consumed-draft approach on current main so every subsequent payload uses normal durable delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history shows this person defined the Mattermost preview ownership and terminal-transition contract.
